rationale: The material prompt requirement is .NET-specific dependency-injection and exporter configuration, native diagnostic APIs or automatic instrumentation, and performance and upgrade-compatibility assessment for the web service. At # OpenTelemetry in Go, the source is scoped to OpenTelemetry in Go — SDK setup, API surface, breaking changes, contrib instrumentation libraries (otelhttp, otelgrpc, otelmongo), compile-time zero-code instrumentation (otelc), and performance tuning. Use when adding, reviewing, or configuring OpenTelemetry in a Go service. Triggers on "setup otel; it provides a meaningful neighbouring route but does not establish .NET-specific dependency-injection and exporter configuration, native diagnostic APIs or automatic instrumentation, and performance and upgrade-compatibility assessment for the web service as required by the prompt.
